---
name: Bug report
about: Something returned wrong data, crashed, or silently failed
title: '[bug] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Module**
Geolocation / Dossier / Infrastructure / Forensics / Sanctions / Server / Build

**What happened?**
A clear description. If a lookup returned data, is it wrong — or fabricated-looking (e.g. appears even with network cut)?

**Input you gave** (use safe/example values — never real personal data in issues)

**Expected behavior**

**Evidence**
Console output, screenshots, or the exact JSON returned.

**Environment**
OS, Node version, browser, `npm run dev` or Docker.

**Checklist**
- [ ] I searched existing issues
- [ ] I am using example/test data, not real personal data, in this report
